name: RC-B10-0174/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking for action. It condemns Thailand for sending at least 40 Uyghur refugees back to China, where they risk detention and torture. It asks Thailand to stop further forced returns, let the United Nations refugee agency see detained Uyghurs, and adopt a fair asylum system. It also asks Thailand to scrap its strict lese-majesty law and other laws used against activists, and to release and amnesty those prosecuted.

- Thailand is urged to stop forced returns and free jailed activists; nothing changes automatically.
- The deported Uyghurs and jailed Thai activists are the people affected.
- The Parliament asks the EU Commission and member states to press Thailand; follow-up is up to them.
